name: -6AN Flare Tee w/ 1/8" NPT Port
description:
ColorFittings AN Flare Tee Fittings with 1/8" NPT Port are precision-engineered to split your AN plumbing line into a T-configuration while simultaneously providing a 1/8" NPT side port for connecting a pressure or temperature sensor, delivering a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, and power steering plumbing systems.

Each tee fitting is CNC machined from 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process for maximum strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. These fittings are designed to withstand high pressure and high temperature environments commonly found in racing, street performance, marine, and aviation applications.

Our AN Flare Tee Fittings with 1/8" NPT Port are manufactured to provide a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically engineered for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. When combined with our nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these tee fittings deliver reliable performance and clean routing for any high-performance plumbing system.

For best installation results, we strongly recommend using our AN Fitting Assembly Tools, which help prevent fitting damage and ensure proper hose and fitting alignment. Please reference our installation video and fitting guide for proper assembly techniques and torque recommendations.

Looking to complete your system? Explore our full range of AN fittings, adapters, braided hose, and fitting assembly tools.
